steps.caption: Master Class
steps.narration: This is the Master Class, a course on the business side of running a construction company.

steps.caption: Modules, state guides, your access
steps.narration: At the top: four modules, a guide for all fifty states, and what your account has unlocked.

steps.caption: Module 1: Business Formation & Licensing
steps.narration: The modules run in order: forming and licensing the business, then Google Business, your website, and SEO and ads.

steps.caption: SEO & ads
steps.narration: Each module has its own tab. Open SEO & ads.

steps.caption: Eight lessons, in order
steps.narration: The outline lists its eight lessons. Choose Google Search Console to jump to that one.

steps.caption: GSC Verification Methods
steps.narration: This lesson walks through verifying your site, with the methods for a domain or a URL-prefix property.

steps.caption: Mark done
steps.narration: When you've finished it, tick Mark done.

steps.caption: Reload the page
steps.narration: Reload the page, and the lesson is still marked done.

steps.caption: 1 of 8 done
steps.narration: One of eight done. Your progress is saved in this browser.

steps.caption: State guide
steps.narration: The State guide tab covers forming and licensing a company where you work.

steps.caption: Pick your state
steps.narration: Pick your state. Colorado has no statewide contractor license, so its guide points to local rules.

steps.caption: Agencies, with checked links
steps.narration: Each agency's tile links to its own site. A link the check couldn't confirm is marked unconfirmed.

steps.caption: Checklist for Colorado
steps.narration: Those agencies become a checklist. Tick each step as you finish it.

steps.caption: Menu: Master Class
steps.narration: You'll find the Master Class in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: Master Class in about a minute | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A one-minute tour of the Master Class in ConstructHUB: four modules of ordered lessons on the business side of contracting, a lesson you mark done, and a guide for every state with its agencies and a checklist you tick off.
